name: Batch Inventory Sync: Airtable to Shopify

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ error: "The inventory sync settings are missing or wrong", problems: $json.problems }) }}

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ 'Inventory sync settings are missing or wrong. ' + $('Code: Start Run').first().json.problems.join('. ') + '.' }}
={{ $('Code: Airtable Read Failed').first().json.message + ($json.error ? ' The Sync Log row could not be saved either.' : '') }}
={{ $('Code: Finish Run').first().json.failMessage || ('Inventory sync ' + $('Code: Finish Run').first().json.runId + ' finished, but the Slack note could not be sent.') }}

parameters.content:
## 1. Start
Every day at 06:00 UTC, or on demand: POST to the Run Now webhook with the header `X-Run-Now-Secret`. A wrong or missing secret gets 401.
The settings are checked first. A Run Now call gets 500 with the problems when one is missing or wrong, otherwise 202 and the run id right away.

## 2. Read Airtable
Active products, Released and Planned batches, Open and Scheduled purchasing requests and existing promos.
Sellable per SKU = units left (made minus reserved minus sold) in Released batches produced on or before today with more than SELL_BY_BUFFER_DAYS to best before, kept in FIFO order. Every Airtable call waits 500 ms after the last one, so even two runs at once stay under 5 requests per second per base. A failed read stops the run before anything changes and leaves a Failed row in the Sync Log when Airtable takes it.

## 3. Shopify
One query reads `available` and `committed` for every synced SKU. Target = sellable minus committed (units in orders that have not shipped yet). Only SKUs that differ get `inventorySetQuantities`, one call per SKU, with `changeFromQuantity` = what Shopify just showed and an `@idempotent` key, so a retry never applies twice and a sale in between is not overwritten. A call that Shopify throttles (or that finds its key still in progress) is sent once more after 2 seconds. Plan Airtable Writes then collects the results.

## Batch inventory sync
Airtable Production Batches are the source of truth for stock. Once a day this workflow works out the sellable stock of every SKU, sets it in Shopify where the number changed, proposes one promo per short dated batch, opens one purchasing request per SKU below its reorder point and writes a Sync Log row.

**Settings** (`$env`): AIRTABLE_TOKEN, AIRTABLE_BASE_ID, SHOPIFY_STORE_DOMAIN, SHOPIFY_ADMIN_TOKEN, SHOPIFY_API_VERSION, SHOPIFY_LOCATION_ID, SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL, RUN_NOW_SECRET, SELL_BY_BUFFER_DAYS (14), PROMO_WINDOW_DAYS (45), PROMO_DISCOUNT_PERCENT (25).

**Run it now**: POST to `/webhook/inventory-run-now` with the header `X-Run-Now-Secret`. It answers 202 with the run id; the results land in the Sync Log and in Slack.

**Errors** go to the error workflow: import shared/error-alert-slack.json, activate it and pick it as this workflow's Error Workflow.

## 4. Write Airtable
New Shopify Stock on Products, one Promo per short dated batch (upsert on Promo Name) and one Open Purchasing Request per SKU below its reorder point (upsert on SKU and Status). 10 records per call, one call per pass. A 429 waits 30 seconds and tries once more.

## 5. Log and notify
One Sync Log row per run (upsert on Run ID). A Slack note goes out when there are new promos, new purchasing requests, something to fix or errors. A run with errors ends at Stop: Sync Failed, so the error workflow alerts you.
